title: AGS Health IPO
summary: AGS Health IPO is a ₹4,800 crore book-built issue, proposed to be listed on BSE and NSE. The IPO dates, price band and lot size are yet to be announced.

b.p: AGS Health IPO has a total issue size of ₹4800 Crores and will be listed on BSE, NSE. Price band & Lot size details are yet to be announced.

AGS Health financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

Incorporated in November 2010, AGS Health Limited is a technology-based company that provides healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) solutions for healthcare providers in the United States. The Company leverages AI technology, data analytics, and a specially developed global delivery model to assist health systems, hospitals, and large physician groups in optimizing their revenue cycles, reducing overheads, and increasing revenue realization. The Company delivers solutions throughout the entire revenue cycle management chain, including patient access, insurance verifications, prior authorizations, clinical documentation, coding, billing, claims, denials, collections, and payment posting. · · The Company delivers end-to-end AI-based SaaS and technology-enabled solutions covering 80% of U.S. healthcare provider revenue cycle management processes. · · AGS Health is operated on a global delivery model with 15,895 employees located in India, the United States, and the Philippines as of March 31, 2026. The employee pool comprises over 4,700 coders, clinical professionals, AI researchers, software engineers, and other specialized healthcare delivery professionals.
BCP Asia II Topco VIII Pte.Ltd. are the company's promoters of AGS Health.
